p.title: Atlas deep links: view and domain parameters ignored or overwritten
p.symptom: ?domain=domain-power-grid&view=domain opened the 하이퍼스케일러 node; a node-only link kept domain=cloud in the URL.
p.root_cause: view was not a route key; the default node cloud-hyperscaler made domain reconciliation pick the cloud domain; the URL was not re-synced after reconciliation.
p.fix: knowledge-route-state adds view; atlas starts in the domain view unless a node is given, leaves the node empty when only a domain is given, and syncs the URL after reconciliation; the landing is now the first domain overview.
p.violated_rule: Owner direction 2026-10-05: the learning hub reads as a professional research library — one contents·document·connections shell, no source/review/boundary chips on the reading surface, and story-form text of 3–5 lines per block that never stops at a one-line definition.
p.prevention: ci-atlas-browser-check deep links (domain/node/module/guide) and URL domain assertions.
p.verification: 4/4 deep links open the requested document.

changelog: **산업·밸류체인 링크 오류 (P1483):** 분야 개요·세부 영역 주소로 들어와도 기본 화면이 열리던 문제를 고치고, 첫 화면을 분야 개요로 바꿨습니다.
